posts.zh:
dsh-skill-picker 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ec0d70afe73d59804be6.html
posts.en:
dsh-skill-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-ec0d70afe73d59804be6.html
